insights.headline: Gold steadies near $4,127 after a two-month low; the rupee's 96.65 defence frames India's day.
insights.summary: Spot gold steadied around $4,127 an ounce on Thursday after touching its lowest since early August, with silver hovering near $60 as traders priced an 80% chance of a December Fed rate hike. Emerging-market outflows of $26.3 billion in September underline the dollar pressure squeezing the rupee, which the RBI is defending near 96.65. For Indian buyers the domestic picture is resilient: Senco Gold posted 31% Q2 revenue growth on festive buying, and jeweller stocks are rallying into the wedding season with 24K gold near Rs 1.46 lakh per 10 grams.
points: Spot gold rose 0.4% to $4,127.40, steadying after a two-month low; silver held near $60.39.
Fed minutes showed a split over further hikes; markets price 18% for October, 80% for December.
EMs saw their first monthly foreign outflow since June ($26.3B) as the hawkish Fed lifted yields and the dollar.
The rupee edged up to 96.65 on likely RBI intervention; reserves fell $50B in three weeks from September's peak.
Senco Gold's Q2 revenue rose 31% on festive demand; the jeweller crossed Rs 10,000 crore in trailing twelve-month sales.

trending.title: Gold's two-month low meets the December-hike math
trending.summary: Gold steadied near $4,127 after its lowest since early August as markets weighed split Fed minutes against 80% December-hike odds; silver below $60 shows the same rate pressure, with bears eyeing $56.

trending.title: The rupee's 96.65 defence is India's gold price
trending.summary: Likely RBI intervention lifted the rupee to 96.65, but $50 billion of reserve erosion in three weeks and relentless FII selling show how the dollar bid keeps domestic gold expensive.

trending.title: Jewellers' Q2 says festive demand is holding at Rs 1.46 lakh
trending.summary: Senco Gold's 31% Q2 growth, Kalyan's robust quarter and a premium IPO listing all point to organised jewellery riding festive and wedding demand despite elevated prices.

trending.title: Yields march higher on both sides of the Atlantic
trending.summary: The ECB is talking more hikes with eurozone inflation at 3.8%, the US 10-year hit a 24.5-year high, and Japanese investors are selling foreign bonds for a third week — a global rate headwind for gold.

items.title: Gold edges higher after hitting two-month low
items.summary: Spot gold rose 0.4% to $4,127.40 an ounce on Thursday, steadying after touching its lowest since August 5 as a firm dollar and higher Treasury yields pressured the metal. Fed minutes showed policymakers divided over further hikes; traders price an 18% October hike chance and 80% for December. Silver rose 0.4% to $60.39. The IMF's Georgieva warned of global risks as Yemen fighting intensified.

items.title: Rupee rises 10 paise to 96.65 against US dollar in early trade
items.summary: The rupee edged up 10 paise to 96.65 against the dollar in early trade on Thursday, likely helped by RBI intervention, after closing at 96.75. It remains pressured by a strong dollar, Brent near $102 on Hormuz supply fears, foreign fund outflows and a $50 billion fall in reserves in three weeks from September's $786 billion peak. FIIs sold Rs 6,121.37 crore of equities on Wednesday.

items.title: Senco Gold Share Price Gains Over 9% After Q2 FY27 Performance Report
items.summary: Senco Gold's shares jumped over 9% after its Q2 FY27 update showed total revenue up 31% YoY and retail revenue up 29%, with same-store sales growth of 19%. The jeweller crossed Rs 5,000 crore in H1 revenue and Rs 10,000 crore on a trailing twelve-month basis; diamond jewellery revenue grew 31% in value. Six new showrooms took the network to 215 stores.

items.title: Hawkish Fed triggers emerging market outflows in September
items.summary: Foreign investors pulled $26.3 billion from EM stocks and bonds in September — the first monthly outflow since June — as a hawkish Fed pushed yields and the dollar higher, the IIF said. EM equities saw $19.2 billion of outflows; $7 billion left EM bonds. The IIF warned a hawkish Fed under Chair Kevin Warsh and further global tightening could hurt EM carry trades in Q4.

items.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD cracks $60 as bears eye $56
items.summary: Silver extended losses below $60, trading around $59.69, as Fed minutes reinforced expectations of another US rate increase toward year-end. It sits below its 50-, 100- and 200-day averages ($64.22, $64.28, $72.78) with the RSI nearing oversold. Analysts flag $56.57 and the year-to-date low of $54.77 as next supports; a recovery must first clear $62.09.

items.title: Kalyan Jewellers Stock Update: Share Price Soars 3% on Robust Q2 Revenue Growth
items.summary: Kalyan Jewellers' shares rose 3% after a robust Q2 FY27 revenue update, with international operations growing about 18% YoY despite a high base. The company sold a non-core real estate asset for about Rs 86 crore, bringing non-gold-metal-loan debt to zero, and launched its first regional brand, Akshaya Thanga Maligai, in Chennai, with four more franchise showrooms planned.

items.title: Nityas Gems & Jewellery shares list at over 9% premium, beat expectations
items.summary: Nityas Gems & Jewellery debuted with a 9.33% premium at Rs 82 on the BSE and 6.67% at Rs 80 on the NSE, beating a faded grey-market premium pointing to a 1.33% pop. The Rs 108.35-crore IPO (Sept 30–Oct 5), priced at Rs 70–75, was subscribed 2.26 times. The company makes lab-grown diamond-studded gold jewellery, supplying organised retailers and selling direct via its Ayaani Diamonds arm.

items.title: PC Jeweller share price jumps over 7% on Q2 update | Stock up 54% YTD — What lies ahead?
items.summary: PC Jeweller's shares jumped over 7% after its Q2 FY27 update reported revenue up 28% YoY and confirmed debt-free status, clearing dues with all 14 consortium banks. The stock is up 54% in 2026, reflecting the turnaround from its debt-resolution phase. The update adds PC Jeweller to a string of jewellers reporting strong September quarters ahead of the festive season.

items.title: Global Market: ECB may need further rate hikes as inflation risks remain elevated, Dolenc says
items.summary: The ECB may need further rate hikes as inflation risks stay tilted up, policymaker Primoz Dolenc said, though timing is uncertain. The ECB has raised its deposit rate twice this year to 2.5% as eurozone inflation hit 3.8%, nearly double the 2% target, with Iran-war energy costs a key risk. Higher rates globally raise the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding gold.

items.title: Japanese investors sell foreign bonds for third straight week as Treasury yields jump
items.summary: Japanese investors sold foreign bonds for a third straight week through October 3 — a net ¥503.6 billion ($3.19 billion) — as surging Treasury yields and rising home returns sapped overseas appetite. The US 10-year hit a 24.5-year high of 5.3645%; Japan's 10-year reached a 30-year high of 3.122%. YTD net foreign bond sales of ¥5.08 trillion are the most since 2022.
